title: Question card
summary: A company's structured question (ADR 0081) in the timeline: the company name with its seal, the question, 2 to 10 large options and one tap to answer. After the tap the card shows the chosen option. It replaces the poll card for these questions only.

answerId.description: PollAnswer.id: the option ID the company sent.

isChosen.description: true when the own user's latest response is this option.

companyName.description: The sender's display name, for bipe_app_question_from.

options.description: In the order the company wrote them.

chosen.description: The text of the chosen option, for bipe_app_question_your_answer.

isClosed.description: The company ended the question (the poll has an end time): bipe_app_question_closed, options off.

isSending.description: true from the tap until the response is in the send queue.

answer.effect: Timeline.sendPollResponse with this one answer. Tapping the chosen option again does nothing. A failure shows bipe_app_poll_vote_error and the old answer stays.

notes: When: a timeline poll (MsgLikeKind poll) whose sender has a verified company seal (company-seal state verified: BipeCompanySeals) and which is single-choice (maxSelections 1) with 2 to 10 answers. Every other poll, a company's too, keeps the poll card of poll-detail. The seal check fails closed: while it loads, or when it fails, the poll card shows.

The card never shows vote counts or who answered: the company reads the answers (ADR 0081, ADR 0082). After the tap the card shows bipe_app_question_your_answer with the chosen text and marks that option; bipe_app_question_change_hint says a tap on another option changes it until the company ends the question.

Large text and contrast for people aged 60 and older (bipe#244): the question in the title text style, each option a full-width button at least 56 points (iOS) or 56 dp (Android) high with the body text style, a visible border in inkPrimary, text that wraps instead of being cut, and the system text size honoured (Dynamic Type, font scale). The chosen option has a filled accent background and a check icon; state is never colour alone.
The header shows the sealCheck icon (label bipe_badge_company) and bipe_app_question_from with the company name; tapping the header opens company-seal.
Each option is a button for VoiceOver and TalkBack: its label is the option text, the chosen one has the selected trait or state. A closed question reads its options as plain text.
The long-press context menu of the poll row is the poll row's own (message-actions, bipe#589); this card does not add or change it.
The Matrix text fallback of the poll (the numbered list the bridge sends, ADR 0081) is for other clients; Bipe draws the card from the poll content.
